text.tspan: Gerbil: package and phase membership / scheduling
Zig: finite native construction and service execution
Share immutable context validation across independent units
Not automatically one indivisible semantic module
Protocol change invalidates dependent native products
L3N: native link; remaining link C can persist
Edit A: re-establish A and affected aggregate products
Rebuild B only if its consumed A assumptions changed
Default dependency is full product; narrower cutoff needs a contract
Bazel actions and boundaries must be declared before execution
Current project tree action remains coarse until authoritative declarations exist
Snapshot group, semantic unit and action are different granularities
DESIGN ONLY: no per-unit Bazel actions, cache implementation or performance run added.
Request identity, content identity, compatibility and admission evidence stay distinct.
